name: identify
description: identify.file: What a file is: format, format families and MIME type, from its first 256 KiB and its name. Pass operation and its arguments; see session describe for one operation's schema.

name: inventory
description: inventory.native: One-call inventory of a native binary: per architecture slice, its kind, interpreter, own name (soname, DLL name or install name), linked libraries, exported and imported symbols, and language markers. inventory.overview: One call for a first look at a native binary: per slice its architecture, kind, entry point, links, how many sections, segments, symbols (defined and undefined) and procedures it has, and which sections look compressed or encrypted. inventory.segments: The layout of a native binary, per architecture slice: its segments and sections with virtual address, size, file offset, bytes in the file, permissions, type and flags. inventory.symbols: Every symbol a native binary names (ELF .symtab and .dynsym with versions, PE exports and imports, Mach-O nlist, wasm imports, exports and names): address, size, kind, binding, section and library. Filters by name, kind and defined or undefined; pages with offset and limit. inventory.procedures: The procedures (functions) of a native binary with start address, size and name where known, merged from every table that records them: symbols, ELF .eh_frame, PE exports and .pdata, Mach-O nlist and function starts, wasm function bodies. Finds functions in stripped binaries. Filters by name; pages with offset and limit. inventory.notes: The notes of an ELF file and what the well-known ones say: GNU build ID, ABI tag (OS and minimum kernel), the property note (x86 IBT/SHSTK and ISA level, AArch64 BTI/PAC), the Go build ID and FDO packaging metadata. inventory.resources: The resources of a PE file (type, name, language, size and file offset of each) and the contents agents ask about: version information (file and product version and every StringFileInfo value such as CompanyName and OriginalFilename), string tables and the application manifest. inventory.go: A Go binary's build information (Go version, main module, every dependency with version, sum and replacement, build settings such as GOOS, GOARCH and CGO_ENABLED) and its functions from the pclntab, which survive stripping. Functions filter by name and page with offset and limit. Pass operation and its arguments; see session describe for one operation's schema.

name: read
description: read.strings: Printable strings in any file (ASCII and UTF-16LE, at any offset), with their file offsets; optionally only those containing a search text. Pages with offset and limit. read.bytes: A slice of any file: `length` bytes from file offset `at`, as hex and a hexdump. search.bytes: Every file offset where a byte pattern occurs (hex with ?? wildcards, or text with optional ASCII case folding), overlapping matches included. Pages with offset and limit. read.address: Map a virtual address to its file offset, or a file offset to its virtual address, through the segments that load the file, and name the section that holds it. read.symbol: Look up a symbol or procedure: by name, its address, size, file offset and section; by address, the symbol and procedure that contain it and the offset into them. read.entropy: Shannon entropy (bits per byte, 0 to 8) of any file: the whole file, each block of a fixed size, and for native binaries each section's bytes. High entropy suggests compressed or encrypted data. Blocks page with offset and limit. Pass operation and its arguments; see session describe for one operation's schema.
